author_rights: Economic rights protected: reproduction, communication, performance, distribution, rental (s. 13(1))
orphan_works: No orphan works provision; collective management organizations may be declared under s. 27A
digital_protection: Circumvention of technological protection measures and rights management information prohibited (ss. 36A, 36B)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing for research, private study, criticism, review, news reporting (s. 13(2)(a))
registration_required: No (voluntary notification under s. 26A; not needed for protection)
